meta.title: Locked garden bed: overgrown bramble hedge, padlocked gate, sign, overgrowth overlay
meta.overgrowthHiRes: overgrowth_q{x}{y}: the same 512 world px tile at 2 cell px/world px, split into 4 cells of 256 world px; tile them as a 2x2 block (x,y in 0..1) or compose once into a 1024 px offscreen canvas and createPattern at 0.5. `overgrowth` is the same tile at 1 px/world px.
meta.note: Locked bed = its soil tile darkened (multiply ~0.62, slight blue) + the seamless `overgrowth` tile on top (ground layer) + hedge_h/hedge_v around the perimeter (same anchor conventions as plank_h/plank_v, steps in tileWorldPx; draw over the planks; leave a gap of ~80 world px for the gate) + `gate` (front-on view, so put it on a horizontal edge, preferably the bottom/front edge nearest the open bed) + `sign` beside it. `gate_side` (beds v2) is the same padlocked gate seen edge-on for the LEFT/RIGHT (vertical) edges: anchor = top centre like hedge_v, it spans tileWorldPx.gate_side world px down the edge (post to post), padlock hangs on its +x side; mirror it (scale x -1) on a left edge so the lock faces the bed opening/player side as you prefer. The hedge is ~48 world px tall, so the bed beyond stays visible.
